text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. Original fictional adult male merfolk prince Rian, age 24. Very pale porcelain skin, muted violet-gray almond eyes, elegant narrow oval face with high softly sculpted cheekbones, straight fine nose and muted rose lips. Long flowing silver-lavender hair in loose waves and airy parted bangs. Translucent blue-lavender fin ears with delicate spines, silver pearl and blue teardrop crystal earrings, thin silver necklace with blue gemstone pendant. Ivory-silver draped toga over LEFT shoulder with circular silver crescent brooch, delicate pearl chains and blue crystal drops, RIGHT shoulder bare. Reserved gentle expression.  One single independent straight-on head-and-shoulders portrait. Eye-level camera, absolutely upright head and level shoulders, eyes looking directly into lens, neutral relaxed closed lips. Entire hairstyle with generous white margin, upper chest visible, hands outside frame. Vertical 3:4.
